timeline.summary: 14 May 2026: Crisil's March-2026 monitoring report shows ₹155.22 Cr of BLS E-Services' IPO proceeds unutilised, with the ₹138 Cr Atyati acquisition still at nil deployment and pushed to FY27.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹323.37 Cr (+35.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹14.74 Cr (+11.7% YoY).
18 May 2026: BLS E-Services' Q4FY26/FY26 investor presentation shows FY26 total income of ₹1,142.8 Cr (+109.7% YoY) and PAT of ₹69.3 Cr (+17.8%), with EBITDA margin down to 8.7% from 15.8%.
BLS E-Services reported Q1FY27 results with 23.3% YoY revenue growth to ₹310 Cr, driven by BC segment expansion and loan disbursement business.
